newReleases.name: Shadow Blocks: 3D Puzzle Game
newReleases.desc:
A block sculpture floats in front of a lakeside landscape. Turn it until its silhouette matches the TARGET shape, and watch it burst into pixel-art colour.

Shadow Blocks is a calm 3D puzzle about seeing a shape from the right angle. No timers, no rush: just you, a pile of blocks and one perfect view.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Swipe left or right to turn the sculpture 90°, up or down to tilt it
• Twist with two fingers to spin it
• The TARGET card draws your current silhouette on top of the goal: green where it fits, red where it spills over
• Undo any move. Stuck? A hint turns the sculpture most of the way, and never costs you a star

200 LEVELS, 10 WORLDS
Meadow, Farm, Sea, Sky, Fairy Tale, Autumn, Winter, Desert, Candy and Safari: 20 puzzles each, every world a little trickier than the last. Collect stars to open the next world.

EARN 3 STARS
Every level has a par, the fewest moves that solve it. Match par for 3 stars, or come back later and beat your own record.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Plays offline, no account needed
• 40 languages
• Satisfying sounds and haptics

FULL VERSION
Shadow Blocks is free to play with ads. The optional one-time Full Version (in-app purchase) removes all ads and gives you unlimited hints. You can also watch a short video for free hints.

newReleases.name: Arrayward

The Signal has called the Unformed to the last warm Core. You are a Warden: build precise arrays of geometric towers along the old roads, upgrade them through each wave, and hold the line before the Core goes dark.

MASTER SIX TOWERS

Pulse brings reliable single-target fire. Burst clears swarms. Frost slows advancing enemies. Lance breaks heavy targets at long range. Arc chains power through groups. Amp strengthens the towers around it. Every tower has three upgrade tiers and a clear tactical role.

OUTTHINK EVERY WAVE

Fast Darts, armored Blocks, shielded Rings, splitting enemies, phasing Ghosts, and bosses force you to adapt. Inspect the next wave, change targeting priorities, send it early for bonus gold, and rebuild your plan when the road changes.

60 CAMPAIGN CHALLENGES

Defend 20 handcrafted maps on Normal, Hard, and Insane. Master single-lane roads, crossings, spirals, forks, and multi-lane assaults. Earn stars and unlock the route to the Source and beyond.

ENDLESS STRATEGY

Every map supports Endless mode. Refine your array, chase a new best wave, and learn how long your Core can survive.

YOUR WAR, YOUR FORM

Arrayward has no forced ads, no account, and no always-online requirement.

them wants something specific.

every treat on the five-by-five tray slides that way; two matching treats
that collide combine into the next one up. But merging alone earns you
nothing. Points come from one place only: making the exact treat an open
order is asking for.

Fill an order and that treat is sold — it leaves the tray for the customer's
box. That is the twist the whole game turns on. You are not building one

are permanent clutter. Four of them and your shift is over, even if half the
tray is still empty.

TWELVE ORDERS TO A SHIFT
Complete twelve and you have worked a full shift. Keep going afterwards if
you want a bigger number, or start clean and try for a faster, tidier run.

newReleases.name: Bible Adventures - The Stories
newReleases.desc:
Bible Adventures is a 16-bit adventure that turns Scripture into something you play.

Don't just read the chapter — walk it. Carry the offering to the altar. Build the ark plank by plank while the crowd mocks you. Lead the animals aboard and feel the door shut behind you. Stand in the valley of Elah with a sling and five smooth stones. Every chapter is a small playable story, and the verse you carry out of it is the real reward.

OVER 1,000 PLAYABLE CHAPTERS
Genesis to Revelation is laid out as a map you work through book by book. The whole Torah, the histories, the wisdom books, the prophets and the entire New Testament are playable today — 1,088 chapters and counting.

BUILT TO TEACH THE WHOLE CHAPTER
Each level is designed to cover its chapter completely: every major event, and the people and places the text actually names. You don't get a summary. You get the chapter, lived.

YOU ACT — YOU DON'T TAP THROUGH
Move with a joystick, act with a button. Gather, carry, build, offer, flee, decide. The turning point of each chapter happens to you, in the world, because of something you did.

SCRIPTURE YOU KEEP
Every chapter lands its defining verse on a card, collected into a verse journal. Recall a verse correctly twice and it's marked mastered.

MADE FOR ALL AGES
Hard passages — a murder, a flood, a judgment — are handled with deliberate restraint: named where Scripture names them, never shown graphically. No chat, no ads, no links out of the game.

A WORK IN PROGRESS, ON PURPOS

newReleases.name: Brain Train: Rail Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
Strange things are happening down in the mine.

Carts roll into the wrong vaults. Lamps go out for no reason. Someone took Old Grizzle's best wrench. And the Company up top wants more gems every week.

So Grizzle hires you.

The job sounds simple. Carts full of gems come out of the tunnel, and each one has to reach the vault with its gem. You tap the turntables to switch the tracks. Grizzle sits on his barrel and takes the credit.

Then the carts start coming faster. Two at a time, then three. An earthquake knocks your turntables the wrong way, a giant worm flips the whole mine upside down, and before you know it you're juggling three routes with a second to spare.

Try out this proper workout for your brain.

What is waiting down there
• Five chapters, each one deeper and stranger than the last
• Six bosses, each with its own trick
• Three stars to earn on every level
• A new Daily Mine every day
• Unlimited mode
• Co-op, versus and endless races with a friend
• Leaderboards, streaks and a gem shop

No login. Play as long as you like. Just you, the carts and a cranky old boss with a golden tooth.

Free to play with ads with the option of an ad-free purchase.

Grab your broom, sponge and spray: it's time to make every room sparkle!

Clean Life is a calm, satisfying cleaning game. Wipe away dust, scrub sticky stains, squeegee foggy windows and bag up the litter, then watch each room go from messy to spotless.

CLEAN 160+ ROOMS IN 16 PLACES
Start in a cosy school, then move on to homes, a hotel, a restaurant, a hospital, a supermarket, offices, a gym, a resort, a train station, an airport, a factory, a fire station, a police station, a car dealership and a construction site.

THE RIGHT TOOL FOR EVERY MESS

RELAXING, NO PRESSURE

REWARDS EVERY DAY
Collect daily gifts, earn stars and achievements, and watch your progress grow across every place you clean.

YOUR PROGRESS IS SAFE
Your progress is backed up to your iCloud, so a new iPhone or iPad picks up right where you left off.

Perfect for short, cosy play sessions, anytime.

newReleases.name: DeepPocket: Watch Diving
newReleases.desc:
A little ocean, right on your wrist.

DeepPocket is a standalone pixel diving game for Apple Watch. Turn the Digital Crown to change depth, scan for nearby echoes and decide what is worth bringing home.

Follow a three-relic expedition
Seek the Coral heart, the Captain’s recorder and the Abyss beacon. Bring each relic safely home to advance the expedition and chart the next sea. Upgrade your hull to reach the deeper destinations.

Choose how to recover
Time the hook in the green zone to save power, or spend more power drilling through a seal. A missed hook costs power, but leaves the find available. Check the full recovery and return budget before committing.

Keep diving after the expedition
Complete haul challenges across the three seas. Meet the material and depth goals, return safely for a bonus, then tackle a new destination and a larger haul.

Make every trip count
Cargo space and battery power are limited. Check the salvage cost, return cost and power remaining after both before choosing your next find. Deeper water brings greater rewards and more pressure.

Build a better submarine
Return safely to bank materials, then improve your battery, cargo bay and hull. Upgrades let you carry more and explore deeper.

Play at your own pace
Leaving the app pauses your dive. Inspecting a find also pauses power consumption while you read. Your progress is saved on the watch, and short sound effects can be switched off.

newReleases.name: Don't Move Game
newReleases.desc:
How still can you hold it?

The game is your iPhone and your hand. Hold it as still as you can: the round locks your starting position by itself, counts down from three, and measures how far the phone drifts. Your Drift Score is that drift in degrees. Lower is better.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic — ten seconds, your main record.
• Endurance — thirty seconds of stillness.
• Sudden Death — move and it is over. Survive up to sixty seconds.
• Daily — the same challenge for everyone, one official attempt a day.
• Poses — Straight Arm, On Your Head, One Leg, Eyes Closed and more, each with its own record.
• Pass & Play — two to eight players on one phone, with optional pose cards. Lowest Drift Score wins, or play a knockout bracket to one champion.

SEE YOURSELF IMPROVE
Every result tells you how far you are from your best and how much you need for the next grade, from CHAOS to UNREAL. Stats follow your Classic rounds over time.

SHARE THE MOMENT
Share a result card or the final Pass & Play ranking.

NO ACCOUNT
Just open it and play. Your results stay on your iPhone. The game is free and shows an ad between some rounds, never during one.

PLAY SAFE
Some poses can end with a dropped phone or a wobble. Play over something soft and give yourself room. Don't Move is a game; Drift Score is not a medical or scientific measurement.

Your spells fire on their own. You just survive.

Evo Swarm is an offline pixel-art survivor roguelite where you steer through monster hordes, dodge danger, collect XP and build outrageous elemental attacks. Your skills attack automatically. Every level-up is your choice. Seven minutes later, a boss is waiting.

EVOLVE YOUR HERO MID-BATTLE

Start small. Grow unstoppable. Five distinct heroes transform through three forms during a run, with unique traits, ultimates and skill trees. Fight wild heroes, find new allies and discover Void, a secret sixth hero you can unlock for free. Void has its own powers and 14 looks, including quest-earned costumes.

FUSE SPELLS. CHANGE EVERYTHING.

Choose your starting elements and shape your build with 106 active skills, 162 passives, 106 evolutions and 106 Final Forms. Discover 33 unique fusions by combining spells from different elements. updates.name: Pixel Flow!

updates.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

updates.name: Yarn Loop: Knit Puzzle
updates.desc:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

all.name: Don't Move Game

all.seller: Loom Games Oyun Yazilim ve Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi
all.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

• Rotate: Tap and drag to spin rings to the target angle.

all.desc:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

all.desc:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.
